AgentDeclaration.description:
Everything discovery publishes about one agent step.

``tools`` are the step's own tools; tools a runtime adds, such as PredictRLM
skill tools, are in its ``runtime`` section.
AgentDeclaration.title: AgentDeclaration

AgentLiveEvent.description: One live event of an agent invocation, as the operator stores and serves it.
AgentLiveEvent.title: AgentLiveEvent

AgentTraceFinished.description:
The end of an invocation: its trace header and the step's outputs.

The turns travelled as live events. ``outputs`` is ``None`` when the run
returned none; files and workspaces appear by reference, and fields too large
to keep are left out and named in ``omitted_outputs``. ``complete`` says
whether every live event of the invocation was delivered.
AgentTraceFinished.title: AgentTraceFinished

AgentTraceHeader.description: Summary every runtime reports for one agent invocation.
AgentTraceHeader.title: AgentTraceHeader

AgentTraceUnavailable.description: An invocation that ended without a trace the runtime could export.
AgentTraceUnavailable.title: AgentTraceUnavailable

ClaudeAgentDeclaration.description:
What a Claude Agent SDK runtime contributes to a declaration.

``model`` is ``None`` when the step leaves the choice to the Claude CLI.
ClaudeAgentDeclaration.title: ClaudeAgentDeclaration

ClaudeAgentTraceHeader.description: Claude Agent SDK session details that have no common-header equivalent.
ClaudeAgentTraceHeader.title: ClaudeAgentTraceHeader

ClaudeAgentTurn.description: The assistant message behind one turn, as the SDK reports it.
ClaudeAgentTurn.title: ClaudeAgentTurn

CodeGenerated.description: The code of a turn still running; the finished turn carries it too.
CodeGenerated.title: CodeGenerated

FieldDeclaration.description: One signature field as shown to people: its name, type name and description.
FieldDeclaration.title: FieldDeclaration

IterationRecorded.description: What a finished turn's live event left out; sent only when it left something out.
IterationRecorded.title: IterationRecorded

Lifecycle.description: Sandbox and artifact lifecycle steps; Avalanche keeps only that they happened.
Lifecycle.title: Lifecycle

PredictRLMConfiguredModel.description: A model set on the step or as a workflow default.
PredictRLMConfiguredModel.title: PredictRLMConfiguredModel

PredictRLMDeclaration.description:
PredictRLM settings after workflow defaults and step overrides are applied.

``settings`` holds the effective constructor options that serialize to JSON,
without credentials or callables. ``extra_options`` names the options
Avalanche has no field for and passes unchanged to PredictRLM; their values
appear in ``settings`` only under the same rules. ``skill_instructions``,
``skill_tools``, ``packages`` and ``modules`` are what the skills add, merged.
PredictRLMDeclaration.title: PredictRLMDeclaration

PredictRLMDefaultModel.description: No model was configured, so PredictRLM picks its own default.
PredictRLMDefaultModel.title: PredictRLMDefaultModel

PredictRLMOmissions.description: Calls left out of a turn that exceeded the live event size limit.
PredictRLMOmissions.title: PredictRLMOmissions

PredictRLMPredictCall.description:
One sub-model call made by the agent's code through ``predict()``.

Its inputs, outputs, error and duration are the matching ``predict`` tool call.
PredictRLMPredictCall.title: PredictRLMPredictCall

PredictRLMTokenUsage.description: PredictRLM's token counts for one model; ``cache_hits`` counts cached calls.
PredictRLMTokenUsage.title: PredictRLMTokenUsage

PredictRLMTraceHeader.description: PredictRLM run details that have no common-header equivalent.
PredictRLMTraceHeader.title: PredictRLMTraceHeader

PredictRLMTurn.description:
PredictRLM's own details of one turn (iteration).

``predict_calls`` describe the turn's last ``len(predict_calls)`` tool calls,
which are its ``predict`` calls, in the same order.
PredictRLMTurn.title: PredictRLMTurn

PredictRLMUsage.description: Usage of the main (code-writing) model and the sub-model, kept apart.
PredictRLMUsage.title: PredictRLMUsage

PredictStarted.description: A sub-model call started by the agent's code.
PredictStarted.title: PredictStarted

RunEnded.description: A run that failed or was cancelled.
RunEnded.title: RunEnded

RunStarted.description:
The call as the runtime started it: the step's inputs and the model it asked for.

Files and workspaces appear by reference. Inputs too large for the event are
left out and named in ``omitted_inputs``.
RunStarted.title: RunStarted

SessionInitialized.description: The CLI's own report of the session it started.
SessionInitialized.title: SessionInitialized

TokenUsage.description: Token counts for one or more model calls; absent figures were not reported.
TokenUsage.title: TokenUsage

ToolCall.description: A tool invoked by the model directly or by code the agent ran.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

ToolDeclaration.description: A tool the agent can call. ``source_code`` is empty when it cannot be read.
ToolDeclaration.title: ToolDeclaration

Turn.description: One model response and the tool calls that followed it.
Turn.title: Turn

TurnFinished.description:
A finished turn.

A turn too large for one live event drops some of its tool calls; the omitted
count says how many, so viewers can show that rather than hide it.
TurnFinished.title: TurnFinished
